meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 WhatsApp 渠道,直接收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要与 WhatsApp 收发消息的应用或机器人.
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel for direct messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app or bot that needs to send and receive WhatsApp messages.

howto.what: 它把 Baileys 版 WhatsApp 适配器拷进项目、注册到渠道表并装好依赖，再跑构建和注册测试；然后用扫码或配对码把 WhatsApp 连上，并把号码模式和助手名写入 .env。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加 WhatsApp 渠道时接管。安装或认证前它会先问这个号是专用号还是你日常在用的号，选共用号会先给出账号风险警告。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 添加 WhatsApp 渠道
say.note: 它先问这个号是专用号还是共用号

say.text: 用配对码方式连接 WhatsApp
say.note: 终端给出 8 位码，你在手机上输入
写入 ASSISTANT_NAME 并同步出站前缀

howto.what_en: It copies in the Baileys WhatsApp adapter, registers it, installs pinned deps, builds and runs the registration test. It links WhatsApp by QR or pairing code, then writes the number mode and assistant name to .env.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw. Before install or auth it asks if the number is dedicated or your everyday one; shared shows an account-risk warning.

say_en.text: Add a WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: It first asks dedicated vs shared number

say_en.text: Link WhatsApp with a pairing code
say_en.note: Type the 8-character code shown into your phone
Writes ASSISTANT_NAME and syncs the prefix
